name: UI Patterns Media Source
description: Adds a Media Browser source plugin to UI Patterns for selecting media via the Media Library modal.
project_description:
Provides a Media Browser source plugin for UI Patterns, allowing content editors to select media (images, videos, documents) from Drupal's Media Library when building components with Display Builder or UI Patterns .

 

 Features 
 
 Media Library integration — Select media directly from Drupal's standard Media Library interface, with full filtering and search support. 
 Native dialog — Uses the browser's native element for a lightweight, accessible modal experience. 
 Live thumbnail preview — Shows the selected media thumbnail immediately after selection. 
 Display Builder ready — Works seamlessly as a source plugin in Display Builder component trees. 
 Single Content Sync compatible — Selected media entities are exported alongside content with UUID support for cross-site imports. 
 Configurable media types — Choose which media types (image, video, document, etc.) are available for selection via the admin settings page. 
 Flexible output — Supports slot (rendered view mode) and URL (with optional image style) prop types to fit different component needs. 
 Proper caching — Component output is automatically invalidated when the selected media or image style is updated.
